sources.core_claim: Month-end cash demand: selling until the settlement deadline (T-4 under T+3), reversal T-3..T+3; US 1995-2013 -17 bp T-8..T-4, +77 bp T-3..T+3; corr -0.54; 2014 EU settlement change moved the reversal (DiD -0.776, t -3.70).
sources.project_applicability: Defines the window and the conditional variant for the C2 E leg retiming.
sources.reflection: US evidence ends 2013 under T+3; trading costs not netted for an index window; post-2015 practitioner evidence says the [-3,+3] window weakened.

sources.core_claim: Losers sold for month-end liquidity in PreTOM [tau-9, tau-4]; ~70% reverses in [tau-3, tau+3]; the May 2024 T+1 reform moved the marginal day from tau-4 to tau-3 (DiD +85.9 bp, t 2.68).
sources.project_applicability: Sets b = tau-4 before 2024-05-28 and tau-3 after; basis for the P500 mechanism measurement.
sources.reflection: Unrefereed, 19-month post-reform sample, shared author with Etula et al.; our 2026 months are outside its sample.

sources.core_claim: Top-quintile dividend payment days: VW market about 8 bp/day vs about 2 bp in the lowest two quintiles; survives turn-of-month controls.
sources.project_applicability: Not a candidate: about 8 bp/day is below a 20 bp round trip under the frozen contract.
sources.reflection: Could condition the dash-for-cash window later if it survives; needs payable dates we do not hold.

sources.reflection: Verbatim sentences via WebFetch; sec.gov served a bot page to curl, so no full-page snapshot.

sources.core_claim: Hull Tactical (2024-05-17): buying SPY at the last trading day close and selling at the 4th trading day close captured 44% of total return while invested about 20% of days.
sources.project_applicability: Negative evidence: the classic post-month-end window is not the trade.
sources.reflection: Harvest excerpt only (2026-09-23); the same rule (TOM_SPY) failed our frozen screen.

hypothesis.statement: H1: SPY earns a higher return from the open after the settlement-implied marginal cash-raising day b (tau-4 before 2024-05-28, tau-3 after; tau = last trading day of the month) to the open after tau+3 than at other times of the month, enough that DFC_U or DFC_C (a) beats E0 under the four-part replacement rule or (b) passes K1 or K2, with a 100-seed random-entry placebo beat rate >= 0.90 in the judged windows.
hypothesis.failure_mode: Post-2015 decay of turn-of-month returns (TOM_SPY close tau -> close tau+4 already has anchor Sharpe -0.69 and stress -0.10 here); about 12 round trips a year at 10 bp/side cost about 2.4%/yr against an index edge the papers put at 48-77 bp per month before costs; SPY calendar windows from 2016 on are contaminated by E0-E7 and TOM_SPY.
hypothesis.measurement: scripts/screen_batch.py --batch t20261001_01_dash_for_cash --iteration t20261001_01_dash_for_cash_settlement (judged Sharpe in select, anchor, stress and the contaminated 2026 window at 10 bp; 20 bp CAGR; K2 edge vs vol-matched S3; DSR), plus scripts/run_t20261001_01_dfc_placebo.py for the 100-seed random-entry placebo, the SPY day-position profile by settlement era and the pre/post window correlation.
hypothesis.stop_pivot: Stop the index line if DFC_U and DFC_C both fail the replacement rule, K1 and K2. Keep the line open for the cross-sectional stage only if T-20261001-02 passes M1. Adopt nothing automatically: a replacement pass is a proposal to the owner because C2 runs on paper under a fixed rule.
